verdict.line: You lose fights you let run long enough for his Darkness Rise to proc and his Indestructible shield to bank; you win the trades where you parry his Death's Grasp or Realm of Death with Riposte and burst him down before either lands.

brief.thesis: This lane sits at 48.1% over 104 games because Fiora's W (Riposte) is a direct counter to both of Mordekaiser's commitment tools - Death's Grasp and Realm of Death - while his Indestructible shield and Darkness Rise passive punish Fiora for grinding out repeated-hit trades instead of sharp ones. Whoever forces the fight onto their own cooldown wins it; whoever gets pulled into the other's rhythm loses it.

theirWindow.when: after he lands 3 hits on you
theirWindow.what: Darkness Rise triggers off 3 landed attacks or spells, giving him a damage aura and bonus Move Speed. Do not keep trading through this window - back off and let it fall off before re-engaging.

yourWindow.when: his E and R are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Death's Grasp (16-8s) and Realm of Death (140-80s) down he has no way to force or escape a fight. Lunge in, chain Burst of Speed attacks to stack your Duelist heal, and use Lunge's free second dash to control the range.

start.why: Run at 49.1% win rate over 106 games and 89.1% pick rate - the extra AD and sustain let you match his early Obliterate poke without falling behind on health.

boots.why: 50% win rate over 58 games and the standard pick - his entire kit (Q, E, R) is magic damage, so the magic resist matters more than usual in this lane.

core.why: Gives you the sustained damage and healing to win extended trades before his shield fully banks.
The core power spike (part of the 53.8% win rate, 22% pick path) that lets you burst through a fight faster than his Indestructible can offset.
Closes out the 53.8% win rate path - the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his delayed magic burst from Q and R.

situational.when: he's ahead and threatening to burst you down before your damage or Indestructible timing matters
the lane stays even and you want to close out the game by split pushing instead of forcing fights
you can isolate him before he lands three hits and triggers Darkness Rise

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher pick-rate page (17.8% pick, 47.6% win rate) - Conqueror's ramping damage and healing rewards you for sustaining through a fight once his shield window has passed. Master-tier Fiora players instead run Press the Attack across 1,122 games, which suits players who want to punish his early poke windows with burst rather than grind out longer trades.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (49.5% win rate, 90.7% pick rate) - this is a skirmish-heavy matchup where Ignite closes out the all-in windows when his E or R is down. Flash + Teleport (62.5% win rate, 6.8% pick) is the higher-win-rate alternative for players prioritizing wave and side-lane management over guaranteed kill pressure.

playing.title: Hold W for his E and R
playing.detail: Riposte parries his next basic attack and reflects magic damage - hold it whenever he's near Death's Grasp range (700) or after he ults you, since blocking his follow-up denies his main sources of damage and control.

playing.title: Disengage before his third hit
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells against you, giving him a damage aura and Move Speed. Break the trade after two hits instead of fighting through the proc.

playing.title: Force his Indestructible early
playing.detail: His W banks damage dealt and taken to create a shield he can consume to heal, on a 12-8s cooldown with effectively unlimited range. Make him use it defensively on a smaller trade so it isn't available for your real all-in.

playing.title: Use Lunge's free second dash to reset
playing.detail: Q can be recast within a couple seconds at no mana cost - use the second dash to leave the fight cleanly rather than committing to a third hit.

playing.title: Track his Obliterate cooldown at levels 3-5
playing.detail: Q drops to a 6s cooldown by rank 3 and hits hardest on a single target - expect frequent poke in this window and don't stand still to trade autos.

playing.title: All-in the instant his E is down
playing.detail: Death's Grasp is his only tool to punish you approaching. When its 16-8s cooldown is on cooldown, Lunge in and chain Burst of Speed attacks to stack your Duelist passive heal before he can reset spacing.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing windows are our own read of the ability kits, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] to block either Mordekaiser’s (E) or his (R). Do not let him maintain his (P) by keeping your distance while fighting him.
